name: Agenda, with travel time
description: The next days as a list: each day on a row, events with their time, location and the drive from home with the time to leave (Waze, through Home Assistant). Events come from Widgets → Calendar Feeds. Requires the Calendar Core plugin, and the Home Assistant Core plugin with the Waze Travel Time integration for the drive.

cell_options.name: feeds_filter
cell_options.label: Calendars
cell_options.help: Feed IDs, separated by commas. Blank shows every enabled calendar.

cell_options.name: show_symbol
cell_options.label: Feed symbol before titles
cell_options.help: The symbol set for a feed in Calendar Feeds. Off by default: it takes width on every title.

cell_options.name: show_travel
cell_options.label: Drive time and time to leave
cell_options.help: For events with a location that have not started yet: the minutes by car from home, and when to leave.

cell_options.name: origin
cell_options.label: Home (start of the drive)
cell_options.help: A Home Assistant zone or device (zone.home), an address, or latitude,longitude. Kept with the page, never in an exported template.

cell_options.name: margin_min
cell_options.label: Margin
cell_options.help: Extra minutes before the time to leave, for parking and getting out of the door.

cell_options.name: travel_days
cell_options.label: Work out the drive for
cell_options.help: Only events in the first days are sent to Waze.

cell_options.name: language
cell_options.label: Language
cell_options.help: The widget's words in this language, whatever the dashboard's.
